acceptance_criteria.informative_group: all four trajectories independently graded and exact first-turn prompt IDs match; binary rewards have nonzero variance
acceptance_criteria.otherwise: retain all evidence and record NO_GO without forcing reward variance or an optimizer update
acceptance_criteria.update: one optimizer update, parameters change, behavior max-absolute log-ratio is at most 0.001, checkpoint save/reload identities match

claim_limits: Do not report held-out improvement, generalization, or a coding RL efficacy result from this one Train task.
A changed LoRA parameter digest establishes an update, not independent capability improvement.
Do not use the grader test, grader output, task, or any trajectories as held-out evidence.
No model run is authorized until the task-specific grader passes baseline/known-fix/wrong-mutant calibration and the shared resource preflight meets every frozen limit.
hypothesis: Four independently sampled trajectories on one qualified Train task may yield an informative exact-prompt GRPO group and an exact on-policy behavior-ratio update. This is a feasibility pilot, not a held-out capability comparison.

policy.python_environment_requirement: Preserve the configured virtual-environment Python entrypoint verbatim; do not resolve its symlinks. Before any rollout, verify mlx.core and mlx_lm import successfully under the exact rollout environment and confirm the MLX device.
policy.trace_mode: stream_generate with exact prompt/completion token IDs and selected-token behavior log-probabilities

resource_limits.hardware: Apple Silicon M1 Pro, 32 GiB unified memory

stopping_rule: Stop before inference on a failed grader, unavailable shared lease, missing local model/runtime, less than 8 GiB free disk or available memory, swap above 0.94, or inability to enforce isolation; stop before update on constant rewards, partial groups, infra grading, token/log-probability mismatch, stale policy, or ratio-tolerance failure.

supersedes.prior_outcomes_or_model_exposure: The first v13 launcher exited at import mlx.core with ModuleNotFoundError. No model was loaded, no model tokens were generated, no candidate source edit was made, and no grading ran. The failed v13 plan, partial progress, and logs remain preserved. A separate leased import-only diagnosis succeeded with the venv entrypoint preserved.
supersedes.reason: V13 stopped before model loading because the runner resolved the virtual-environment Python symlink to the base Miniforge interpreter, which does not contain mlx. V14 preserves the configured interpreter entrypoint and records an exact-environment runtime check before rollout.

task.reward: 1 only when the isolated independent grader passes all three pinned backward tests; otherwise 0. Infrastructure-ungraded attempts abort the whole group.
task.task_units: one source task; no development or held-out claim

update.checkpoint: save adapter, optimizer state, RNG schedule, and verify reload identity before accepting the update
update.objective: existing vare.grpo_mlx.train_step on the first-turn completions, grouped only when the exact prompt token sequences match
update.reward_assignment: terminal independently graded outcome for the full coding trajectory
